system.biography:
A unicorn has deep sea-blue, violet, brown, or fiery gold eyes. Males sport a white beard.

A typical adult unicorn grows to 8 feet in length, stands 5 feet high at the shoulder, and weighs 1,200 pounds. Females are slightly smaller and slimmer than males.

Unicorns speak Sylvan and Common.

Combat

Unicorns normally attack only when defending themselves or their forests. They either charge, impaling foes with their horns like lances, or strike with their hooves. The horn is a +3 magic weapon, though its power fades if removed from the unicorn.

Magic Circle against Evil (Su)

This ability continuously duplicates the effect of the spell. A unicorn cannot suppress this ability.

Spell-Like Abilities

Unicorns can use detect evil at will as a free action.

Once per day a unicorn can use greater teleport to move anywhere within its home. It cannot teleport beyond the forest boundaries nor back from outside.

A unicorn can use cure light wounds three times per day and cure moderate wounds once per day (caster level 5th) by touching a wounded creature with its horn. Once per day it can use neutralize poison (DC 21, caster level 8th) with a touch of its horn. The save DC is Charisma-based.

Wild Empathy (Ex)

This power works like the druid’s wild empathy class feature, except that a unicorn has a +6 racial bonus on the check.

Skills

Unicorns have a +4 racial bonus on Move Silently checks. *Unicorns have a +3 competence bonus on Survival checks within the boundaries of their forest.

Celestial Charger

The celestial charger described here is an 8 HD celestial unicorn with seven levels of cleric.

Combat

The save DC for this celestial charger’s neutralize poison ability (DC 20) is adjusted for its greater Hit Dice and altered Charisma score.

A celestial charger’s natural weapons are treated as magic weapons for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction.

Smite Evil (Su)

Once per day a celestial charger can make a normal melee attack to deal 15 points of extra damage against an evil foe.

Cleric Spells Prepared (6/7/6/5/4; save DC 18 + spell level)

0—detect magic, detect poison (2), light, virtue (2); 1st—bless (2), calm animals*, obscuring mist, remove fear, sanctuary, shield of faith; 2nd—aid* (2), animal messenger, lesser restoration, remove paralysis, shield other; 3rd—prayer, protection from energy, remove curse, searing light (2); 4th—air walk, divine power, holy smite*, restoration.

*Domain spell. Domains: Animal and Good.

system.benefit: You get a +2 bonus on all Listen checks and Spot checks.

system.description: Choose a skill. You are particularly capable at that skill.
system.benefit: You get a +3 bonus on all checks involving the chosen skill.
system.special: You can gain Skill Focus multiple times. Each time you take the feat, it applies to a new skill.

system.description: You can make running or standing jumps.
Your Listen check is either made against a DC that reflects how quiet the noise is that you might hear, or it is opposed by the target's Move Silently check.
Make a Move Silently check when you try to sneak past enemies or move without being heard.
Your Spot check is either made against a DC that reflects how obvious the object is, or it is opposed by the target's Hide check.
You are skilled at surviving in the wild and at following tracks.

What it does (SRD): The creature can see in total darkness out to the distance set on each copy (overrides or the stat block). Darkvision is black and white only unless another rule says otherwise.

ThirdEra: Canonical template uses a blank range under Capability grants; set per-copy distance under CGS parameters and overrides.

What it does (SRD): In starlight, moonlight, torchlight, and similar dim lighting, the creature can see twice as far as a human can in the same light. It retains the ability to distinguish color and detail under those conditions that a human could not.

ThirdEra: Low-light vision is set on this item’s Details tab under Capability grants (vision and senses), not in Mechanical effects (no extra distance is needed for the usual reading of the rule). The character sheet includes it with other vision from items and race.

What it does (SRD): Scent lets the creature detect opponents by smell, usually out to about 30 ft. (strong scents farther, very weak scents closer). It can use scent to pinpoint a square once it is within 5 ft., and to track by Survival. Wind and water affect what it can smell.

ThirdEra: Scent (30 ft.) is set on this item’s Details tab under Capability grants (vision and senses), not in Mechanical effects. The character sheet includes it with other senses; Survival checks to track by scent still use the normal skill rules unless you add separate bonuses elsewhere.

Unicorn spell-like abilities (SRD): Detect evil at will; greater teleport 1/day within its home forest; cure light wounds 3/day, cure moderate wounds 1/day (touch with horn, CL 5th); neutralize poison 1/day (touch, CL 8th, DC Charisma-based).

Magic circle against evil (Su): Continuous as magic circle against evil; cannot be suppressed.

Wild empathy (Ex): As the druid class feature with a +6 racial bonus on checks.

Skills: +4 racial on Move Silently; +3 competence on Survival within its forest.

Horn: Treated as a +3 magic weapon while attached; loses enhancement if removed.

What it does (SRD): The creature is immune to poison: it does not take ability damage or hit point damage from poison, and it ignores other harmful poison effects unless a specific effect overrides immunity.

ThirdEra: On this item’s Details tab, poison immunity is under Capability grants (immunity), not as save or AC bonuses in Mechanical effects. The character sheet lists it with other immunities and defenses from the creature’s items and features.
